title: Twig Slime (M)

moves.title: Sticky Shot
effects: Add 1 Slimed card to discard pile

move_pattern: Starts with Sticky Shot. Then randomly alternates between Pokey Pounce (twice as likely) and Sticky Shot, avoiding consecutive Sticky Shots.
notes: This monster has Phobia Spine Skin enabled via the HasPhobiaSpineSkin property.
